license_nft_mint: <base58 License NFT mint of the operating license>
_comment_store_authority: OMIT store_authority until the governed StoreReleaseListing bootstrap has created an exact Active listing for every served release. Adding the StoreOperatorAuthorization.store_authority public key enables that target-scoped policy.
rpc_fallback_urls: <independently trusted endpoint for the same cluster>
_comment_pearl_control_mtls: REQUIRED when policy.require_pearl_control_for_app_publish=true. This is a private listener; do not route it through the public catalog edge. The SHA-256 is over the Pearl client certificate DER, not a public key or CA certificate.

pearl_control_mtls.pearl_client_cert_sha256: <lowercase sha256 of Pearl client certificate DER>

boot_identity._comment: OMIT this block for a READ-ONLY store (operator nil, legacy /publish 503 or 410 after Pearl cutover). Set it to enable governed app publishing (B1-02). DEPLOYER MUST also register an Active on-chain SidecarIdentityEntry (register_sidecar_identity) pinning the derived signing/encryption pubkeys + this store's domain hash, sha256(tls cert DER), and the binary hash.
